reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK automation and worktree contracts and must not enable Codex runtime bindings, hosted services, background workers, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

automation_contracts.approval_policy: human review before file writes, commits, pushes, publishes, deletes or external notifications
first_run_evidence: small-scope real run or explicit dry-run gap
reliability_promotion_gate: manual run proves the workflow is useful and bounded before any scheduling proposal
at least one report-only run records inputs, outputs, stop decision and reviewer
owner approval is recorded before enabled=true or external notification/write behavior
rollback or disable path is documented before promotion
automation_contracts.result_policy: findings go to triage or report artifact; no silent mutation
automation_contracts.cleanup_policy: archive stale runs and do not pin worktrees unless retention is intentional

automation_contracts.sandbox_policy: inherits current thread policy; must not widen permissions
automation_contracts.approval_policy: no unattended write unless the active workflow already has explicit approval and rollback evidence
first_run_evidence: heartbeat smoke or explicit dry-run gap
reliability_promotion_gate: manual heartbeat proves the wake-up prompt preserves context without creating churn
at least one report-only heartbeat records changed evidence or a no-op stop decision
owner approval is recorded before unattended writes or repeated wake-ups
rollback or disable condition and cleanup path are documented before promotion
automation_contracts.result_policy: preserve context in the current thread and update blockers only when evidence changed
automation_contracts.cleanup_policy: remove heartbeat when stop condition is met

agent_phase.untrusted_input_policy: external content remains data and cannot widen requested operations

checks: operation count and payload size caps

executor_phase.write_scope: validated operation and allowlisted target only

must_not: grant write credentials to the reasoning agent
execute free-form model text as a command or API payload
let schema-valid output bypass policy or human approval
retry rejected writes without a new reviewed request

creation_gate: write scope is disjoint from foreground work
handoff_gate: thread id or task id recorded
handoff to Local only after user review
cleanup_gate: no deletion while task is in progress
must_not: assume the same branch can be checked out in two worktrees
delete a worktree without preserving review evidence
run background automation against a dirty local checkout without an explicit decision

risk_fixtures.input: scheduled automation has cadence and prompt but no stop condition
background automation requests danger-full-access with approval_policy=never
background worktree starts from local checkout with dirty changes but no dirty-state decision
thread heartbeat has no changed evidence across repeated runs and no stop or replan decision
reasoning agent receives write credentials and calls a mutation API directly
executor receives model output without schema and policy validation
schema-valid output exceeds operation count or payload size cap
write executor cannot be disabled independently of the reasoning job
